title: Tool Call MITM (ProxyBot)
summary: As documented, an intermediary reads and can change tool inputs and outputs, including signing keys and fund transfers.

LC.rationale: In the default simulated configuration no model is called and MCP agents are tool servers invoked directly by callers; the documented proxy path is not implemented, so no natural-language path reaches a security-relevant sink.

CP.rationale: ProxyBot keeps no memory; the only cross-session store is MemoryBot's in-process list, which is unrelated to this path and does not alter standing behaviour.

AP.rationale: The effect is confined to the ProxyBot MCP tool server; no handoff to another agent, tenant, or policy domain occurs, and A2A handoffs are declared but not implemented.

RH.rationale: No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel is on the path; the scripted handlers return fixed results and no reward-hacking episode is observed or reachable.

ES.rationale: ProxyBot resolves any tool name with no authentication or schema constraint, and the tool binding surface is unvetted and dynamic.

agentic_applicability.rationale: scored as modeled; default config is scripted. The lab models ProxyBot as an MCP tool server invoked directly by callers; even in optional LLM mode no tools are passed to the model, so the agent does not pursue goals or sequence actions.
